text: Learning a new skill takes time and effort. First, you need to practise regularly, even if it is only for a short time each day. Patience is important because progress can be slow at the beginning. There are many resources you can use, such as books, videos, or apps. It also helps to track your progress, for example by keeping a diary or setting small goals. Finally, staying motivated is key. Remember why you started, and celebrate each small success. With practice and patience, you will improve step by step.
